AreaChart.description: Multi-series area chart, including stacked and signed values.

BarChart.description: Grouped or stacked vertical/horizontal bar chart.

HorizontalBarChart.description: Horizontal orientation of the same upstream BarChart engine.

LineChart.description: Multi-series line chart with configurable interpolation and dots.

HeatmapChart.description: Value heatmap with missing cells and signed diverging color scales.

RadarChart.description: Multi-series radar chart with polygon or circular grids.

PieChart.description: Pie or donut chart with a keyboard-accessible interactive legend.

RadialChart.description: Circular or semicircular radial magnitude chart.

FunnelChart.description: Actual curved/straight multi-stage funnel with upstream geometry.

SegmentedBar.description: Proportional segmented bar with interactive legend.

SingleStackedBar.description: Compatibility name for the same upstream SegmentedBar core.

ScatterChart.description: Multiple named scatter datasets with finite signed coordinates.

CalendarHeatmap.description: Contribution calendar with real date geometry, sparse days and level patterns.

MiniAreaChart.description: Compact upstream area sparkline with signed values.

MiniBarChart.description: Compact upstream bar sparkline with signed values.

MiniLineChart.description: Compact upstream line sparkline with signed values.

Text.description: Plain text with a semantic tone. HTML is displayed literally.

Alert.description: Supplied notice with visible title and explanation.

Table.description: Supplied scalar data table. Row keys must be declared column keys; use @Each to project business records before rendering.

Input.description: Labeled single-line text input bound to local state.

Select.description: Labeled single selection from supplied options.

Icon.description: A bundled official SVG icon with semantic tone and a fixed optical size.

Image.description: Image subject to the host media policy.

Video.description: Native video with real browser controls and optional captions. Embedded media works offline; remote media requires an explicit host policy.

CodeView.description: Supplied code View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

MathView.description: Supplied math View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

BlockquoteView.description: Supplied blockquote View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

SectionView.description: Supplied section View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

FigureView.description: Supplied figure View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

DetailsView.description: Supplied details View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

CitationView.description: Supplied citation View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

MetricView.description: Supplied metric View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

StepsView.description: Supplied steps View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

ChecklistView.description: Supplied checklist View rendered with the shared Inform foundation theme.

Series.description: Named finite series; null is supported only by HeatmapChart as a missing cell.

Slice.description: Named non-negative magnitude for pie, radial, funnel or segmented charts.

Point.description: A finite scatter coordinate. Negative and zero values are supported.

ScatterSeries.description: Named scatter dataset containing finite Point values.

CalendarDay.description: ISO calendar day and non-negative magnitude. Duplicate dates are summed by the upstream calendar.

CodeData.description: Strict supplied record for CodeView. Conditional variants are enforced by the same bounded validator.
